title: ExplorerContent
responsibility: Shows any address of the explorer for a host without a page for each screen: picks the one screen entry the address is and draws nothing of its own.

inputs.name: ExplorerContent.index
inputs.description: Prepared history index for the selected repository and its recorded revisions.

inputs.name: ExplorerContent.head
inputs.description: Exact selected source revision supplying every displayed contract, measurement and capture.

inputs.name: ExplorerContent.parent
inputs.description: First parent of the selected commit, or null at a branch tip or first commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerContent.scope
inputs.description: Selected branch, commit and comparison scope shared by the explorer host.

inputs.name: ExplorerContent.route
inputs.description: Current explorer location, including category, entity, section and tab.

inputs.name: ExplorerContent.entities
inputs.description: Units projected from the selected revision, including entities removed by the shown commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerContent.lens
inputs.description: Host-provided readers for entity relationships, history and selected-revision details.

inputs.name: ExplorerContent.client
inputs.description: Revision reader used only for commits the displayed history requests.

inputs.name: ExplorerContent.mediaBase
inputs.description: Base URL for retained recorded evidence media.

inputs.name: ExplorerContent.onroute
inputs.description: Receives the requested explorer destination for host-controlled navigation.

outputs.name: ExplorerContent.anyExplorerScreen
outputs.description: The one screen the address is, for a host without a page for each screen. States: catalog: The content area displays the component collection. pages: The content area displays the Pages collection. missing: The requested entity is absent and its recovery notice is shown. configs: The content area displays source-based configuration tables. functions: The content area displays the callable collection. styles: The content area displays the shared style inventory. dependencies: The content area displays the dependency inventory. translations: The content area displays the translation inventory. modules: The content area displays the module inventory. permissions: The content area displays declared permissions. platforms: The content area displays supported platforms.

errors.name: ExplorerContent.callerError
errors.description: Caller-provided snippets, navigation and synchronous reader callbacks may throw; those errors propagate. This component defines no additional error type.
